candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001],
You have carte blanche on this. Because it is a sample piece, I will trust your judgement.
Tell me if you need anything from me.
[CLIENT_NAME_002]

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Hello [FREELANCER_NAME_001]!
What would your total quote be for 80-85 pages?
Thanks!
[CLIENT_NAME_002]

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The current projection is 85 pages of comic. Here are the next two scripts. I believe I also sent you a version of the novel, which is divided into three sections. That may serve as a better source than the scripts. Please review everything and tell me what you think.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: I am sorry for the misunderstanding. I am hoping to obtain funding, and the sample I paid for was part of that effort. If the campaign succeeds, I will proceed with the project. I am not requesting any work from you at this time. However, if you prefer to withdraw, please tell me ASAP.
